name: generate_business_model_canvas
description: Generates a Business Model Canvas from a user's startup idea.

bmc.description: Markdown formatted content containing the complete Business Model Canvas with all 9 sections

prompt.system: Create a concise Business Model Canvas using the nine Osterwalder / Strategyzer building blocks. Use Markdown. Separate supplied facts from hypotheses. Do not invent customers, partnerships, revenue, or validated prices.
prompt.user:
Given this idea: {{idea_description}}, create a Business Model Canvas with exactly these top-level headings:

# Key Partners
# Key Activities
# Key Resources
# Value Propositions
# Customer Relationships
# Channels
# Customer Segments
# Cost Structure
# Revenue Streams

Use 2 to 4 short, concrete bullets per block, at most 15 words per bullet. Identify proposed partners as candidates. Label unvalidated assumptions. Do not add an introduction or conclusion.

At the very end of the Key Partners section, append exactly one fenced code block with the language tag `bmc-key-partners-integrations`. Inside that block, output strict JSON using this schema only: {"suggestedServiceIds":["service-id-1","service-id-2"]}. Include only service IDs from this allowlist: google, apple, microsoft, notion, slack, asana, trello, jira, monday, clickup, meta, linkedin, x, reddit, zapier, n8n, make, figma, canva, adobe, openai, github, gitlab, bitbucket, vercel, stripe, quickbooks, xero, google-analytics, hubspot, mailchimp, salesforce, dropbox, box, docusign, hellosign, intercom, zendesk, shopify, woocommerce. Use 0 to 4 IDs, keep them lowercase, and do not include any explanation outside the JSON within that block.

For Cost Structure, use a compact Markdown worksheet instead of bullets. State the currency and MVP planning horizon explicitly; mark either as an assumption if not supplied. Use columns Cost driver | Estimate | Cadence | Basis. Include 4 to 6 items. Cadence must distinguish one-time, monthly, annual, or per-unit costs. Basis must identify a supplied figure, illustrative assumption, or quote needed. Use TBD when no defensible estimate is available, never zero for an unknown. After the table give separate one-time and monthly subtotals only when all relevant rows are numeric in one currency; label partial subtotals as incomplete. Never add monthly and one-time amounts into an unlabeled total. Keep Revenue Streams separate and concise.
